title: Concept: Access granted before the address was verified
description: An access token issued while the e-mail is marked unverified in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The mailbox is the recovery channel, so an account created with an address the user does not own can be recovered by whoever does own it.
applicability: Deployments that render an access token issued while the e-mail is marked unverified into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The mailbox is the recovery channel, so an account created with an address the user does not own can be recovered by whoever does own it.
